title: Tap left Cmd alone -> F19 (Hammerspoon turns it into Mission Control, GNOME Activities-style)

rules.description: Tap left Cmd alone -> F19. Lives in Karabiner, not Hammerspoon, because Hammerspoon never sees the Tab in Cmd+Tab (AltTab/app switcher eat it) but does see Karabiner's fake Cmd release from the Tabby Esc-prefix rule. Hammerspoon binds F19 and vetoes it if the mouse was used while Cmd was held, which Karabiner can't see (no trackpad access).
